name: Crash Bandicoot Retro HiJinx
summary: Crash Bandicoot Retro HiJinx is a Crash Bandicoot fangame, infamous for its first demo containing pseudo-malware that deletes Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy and Crash Bandicoot 4: It's About Time off your computer once booted up. The pseudo-malware has been removed since, but please install with caution. The description from GWKTM's website reads: "After countless lack-luster revivals, the true orange island-hopping bandicoot we know and love, is coming back for real, and in condition of his life! Join Crash and Coco, as they dish out some justice once again in their most polygon-perfect crystal hunt in decades!"
